57/S0.subgoal: Explain the basic idea of the viewing pipeline and identify its transformations and operations that support VR resource optimization.

57/S1.subgoal: Describe how the 3D viewing transformation uses camera parameters to define a view coordinate system and transform world coordinates into view coordinates.

57/S2.subgoal: Explain projection transformation, including perspective and parallel projection, view volume and canonical view volume, and the matrix steps used to project points onto the view plane.

57/S3.subgoal: Describe how the window-to-viewport transformation maps a projected point from an abstract window to a device-specific viewport.

57/S4.subgoal: Explain how clipping and hidden surface removal discard unnecessary geometry before projection and reduce rendering computation.

57/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the next pipeline stage.
